---
title: "Member Login"
---

SASA memberships are managed on the Glue Up platform. Log in to view the events for which you are registered and to see your SASA membership details.

[Log in to your SASA profile on Glue Up](https://app.glueup.com/org/sastat/memberships){.btn-sasa}

Once logged in, please click on the **Events**, **Memberships** and **Subscriptions** links to see the events for which you are registered and to view your SASA membership details. You will be redirected to the SASA profile on the Glue Up platform.

Not a member yet? [Apply for SASA membership](apply-for-sasa-membership.qmd). Want to change your details or join an interest group? See [Update your SASA profile](update-profile.qmd).
